items.title: M0 profile and red performance baseline
items.context: M0 acceptance: run the current command `node packages/main/dist/tasks/playbook-runtime-memory-baseline-smoke.js --profile=full` and record a red/profile artifact showing the present full 1,000,000-record warm/cache path does not prove the target. The unmet target is indexedWarmCacheMs <= 2000ms on the full profile with parityPass=true; current baseline is expected to exceed or remain report-first. The profile must identify token scan, pack build, cache behavior, index build, and query count timing enough to guide M1-M5.

happy.desc: Full-profile baseline reports current reference/indexed/warm timings and targetStatus=unmet when indexedWarmCacheMs exceeds 2000ms.

edge.desc: Profile output includes enough breakdown to distinguish token matching, pack build, cache, index build, and query count timing.

adversarial.desc: M0 cannot be marked green by report-first wording alone; it must record the concrete unmet target or pass/fail status.

verificationEvidence.note: Red/profile baseline before optimization recorded referenceFullScanMs=46325 indexedColdMs=12427 indexedWarmCacheMs=3270 targetWarmMs=2000, so the then-current warm/cache path did not meet the target.

Final full profile reports referenceFullScanMs=52681 indexedColdMs=9977 indexedWarmCacheMs=1 indexBuildMs=26241 exactFastPathHits=100 fuzzyIndexHits=126 cacheHitRate=0.500, giving the requested breakdown.
The smoke now exits non-zero if targetStatus is not met, so M0 cannot be closed by report-first wording alone.

items.title: M1 semantic parity guard
items.context: M1 acceptance: add golden semantic parity coverage for exact token, fuzzy/includes match, superseded suppression, candidate suppression, stale-relevant, stale-irrelevant, deprecated brand residue, malformed rows, maxLines, and omittedCount. The guard command must compare reference and optimized MemoryFreshnessPack result digests and fail on any semantic drift before performance optimization can be marked done.

happy.desc: Reference and optimized MemoryFreshnessPack result digests match for exact-token and normal active memory cases.

edge.desc: Superseded, stale-relevant, stale-irrelevant, deprecated residue, malformed row, maxLines, and omittedCount behavior remain identical.

adversarial.desc: A candidate or stale playbook must not surface as current guidance, and semantic drift must fail the parity guard.

verificationEvidence.note: M6 report shows referenceResultDigest and optimizedResultDigest both 19e61cac88d5e038e5114c0059eb7b259ba7e8685c04dc7fdd41ed2c63bf1dc8 with semanticParity=pass.
Semantic guard reports candidateFalseSurfaceRate=0 supersededFalseSurfaceRate=0 deprecatedFalseSurfaceRate=0 malformedRowsSkipped=5 and render line-cap checks passed.
Candidate, stale, superseded, deprecated residue, and malformed playbook cases are exercised by M5/M6 and fail the smoke on drift; current run passed TOTAL 8 PASS 8 FAIL 0.

items.title: M2 exact-token fast path
items.context: M2 acceptance: implement exact-token O(1) lookup for runtime memory index candidate selection while preserving the M1 parity guard. The full-profile benchmark must still report parityPass=true and show lower indexedColdMs or matchingIds/token-scan time than M0. No memory pack may become gate evidence or authoritative.
items.userSees: Expected transcript includes `exactFastPathHits=<n>`, `tokenScanFallbacks=<n>`, `parityPass=true`, and an improved indexed/token-scan timing versus M0.

happy.desc: Exact query tokens use direct tokenToIds lookup and produce the same candidate set/order as the reference path.

edge.desc: Exact lookup respects candidateLimit, corpus order, superseding entries, and empty-query recent-entry fallback.

adversarial.desc: The exact fast path must fall back safely for fuzzy-only cases instead of dropping results or changing MemoryFreshnessPack digest semantics.

verificationEvidence.note: Exact-token lookup is covered by indexedReferenceParity=true on small smoke and exactFastPathHits=100 on the 1,000,000-record M6 report, with matching result digest.
CandidateLimit windows, superseding entries, and cached/uncached selection are covered; M3 candidateLimit check proved distinct windows and cache keys.
Fuzzy-only and fallback-sensitive paths remain covered by digest parity and tokenScanFallbacks=0 in normal full-profile queries; semantic drift fails the guard.

items.title: M3 prefix or fuzzy auxiliary index
items.context: M3 acceptance: implement a bounded fuzzy auxiliary index, such as prefix/trigram/equivalent, so fuzzy/includes behavior no longer requires scanning every tokenMap entry for normal queries. The M1 parity guard and full 1,000,000-record parity must pass, and the profile must report fuzzy index hits/fallbacks so regressions are visible.
items.userSees: Expected transcript includes `fuzzyIndexHits=<n>`, `fuzzyFallbacks=<n>`, `parityPass=true`, and no all-token scan for normal fuzzy queries.

happy.desc: Fuzzy/includes query cases are served by a bounded auxiliary index while preserving result digest parity.

edge.desc: Prefix/trigram or equivalent fuzzy indexing handles short tokens, file kinds, story phases, and host/context tokens without unbounded scans.

adversarial.desc: If fuzzy index cannot prove coverage, fallback is bounded and visible in counters rather than silently performing an unreported whole-token scan.

verificationEvidence.note: Runtime index schema v2 adds fuzzy token maps; full M6 report shows fuzzyIndexHits=126 with digest parity preserved.
Small smoke covers indexedReferenceParity=true with fuzzyIndexHits=11 fuzzyFallbacks=0 tokenScanFallbacks=0 across query/context tokens.
Fallback counters are explicit and visible; full M6 normal queries report fuzzyFallbacks=0 tokenScanFallbacks=0, so unbounded scans would be detected.

items.title: M4 persistent cache and prebuilt index lifecycle
items.context: M4 acceptance: add durable cache or prebuilt index lifecycle that survives CLI process boundaries and is strictly bound to schemaVersion, consumer, normalized query/context, contributing source digests, runtime config digest, consumer policy version, limits, indexVersion, and projectRoot. Stale source/config/index/policy changes must miss or downgrade safely; fresh second-process lookup must hit.

happy.desc: A second CLI/process can reuse a durable cache or prebuilt index for the same bound query/context and produces the same pack digest.

edge.desc: Source/config/policy/indexVersion/limit/projectRoot changes invalidate or downgrade cache reuse safely.

adversarial.desc: A stale durable cache entry cannot be consumed as fresh after contributing source mutation or cache key shape drift.

verificationEvidence.note: M4 smoke reports crossProcessCacheHit=true with a sha256 cacheKeyDigest, proving durable cache reuse across a second process for the same bound query/context.
M3/M4 cache cases cover unchanged hits, contributing source mutation misses, stale-irrelevant broad source changes, candidateLimit separation, and advisory-only metadata.
After contributing source mutation, the second-process run reports staleMutationMiss=true/contributingMisses=1 and cannot consume stale cache as fresh.

items.title: M5 performance gate and benchmark report
items.context: M5 acceptance: add a user-visible benchmark command `node packages/main/dist/tasks/playbook-runtime-memory-performance-smoke.js --profile=full --targetWarmMs=2000` or equivalent. It must fail if full-profile parity is false, candidate/superseded/stale/deprecated/malformed semantics drift, authority/gateEvidence changes, or indexedWarmCacheMs exceeds 2000ms. It must also report referenceFullScanMs, indexedColdMs, indexedWarmCacheMs, p50/p95 where available, peak RSS, cache hit rate, and performance policy.
items.userSees: Expected transcript includes `playbook-runtime-memory performance smoke passed`, `recordCount=1000000`, `parityPass=true`, `indexedWarmCacheMs<=2000`, and `targetWarmMs=2000`.

happy.desc: The full-profile performance smoke passes only when parityPass=true and indexedWarmCacheMs is at or below targetWarmMs=2000.

edge.desc: The performance smoke reports referenceFullScanMs, indexedColdMs, indexedWarmCacheMs, p50/p95 or equivalent repeated-query latency, peak RSS, and cache hit rate.

adversarial.desc: The performance smoke exits non-zero when parity fails, advisory metadata changes, or indexedWarmCacheMs exceeds targetWarmMs.

verificationEvidence.note: Full performance smoke passed with recordCount=1000000 parityPass=true indexedWarmCacheMs=1 targetWarmMs=2000 targetStatus=met.
Output reports referenceFullScanMs=52681 indexedColdMs=9977 indexedWarmCacheMs=1 p50WarmMs=0 p95WarmMs=0 peakRssBytes=3528818688 cacheHitRate=0.500 performancePolicy=report-first.
The smoke gates semanticGuard.pass, parityPass, non_authoritative/gateEvidence=false, and indexedWarmCacheMs<=targetWarmMs; any drift exits non-zero.

items.title: M6 rollout docs validation and version bump
items.context: M6 acceptance: create/update docs/requirements/decisions/playbook-memory-performance-index-optimization-plan.md with the actual implementation path and measured results, run build plus the parity/performance/full-profile smokes, complete review assurance, advance DONE, and bump the CLI patch version after merge. Final claim may say the 1-2s full-profile hot path is proven only if M5 performance smoke passes with indexedWarmCacheMs <= 2000ms; otherwise it must explicitly remain report-first/blocking.
items.userSees: Expected DONE summary includes `Proofbound CLI <new version>`, exact before/after timings, `full-3x2`, and whether `indexedWarmCacheMs<=2000` is proven.

happy.desc: Execution plan doc records actual implementation, before/after metrics, exact verification commands, and final CLI version after DONE merge.

edge.desc: Docs preserve the advisory memory boundary and do not describe memory as gate evidence or authoritative proof.

adversarial.desc: Final summary and docs cannot claim 1-2s complete unless the M5 full-profile performance smoke passed with indexedWarmCacheMs<=2000.
